generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

Contractor should follow strictly the prevailing rules of labour act. Contractors are directed to employ only the labours who are registerd in Labour Department, if the labours are not registerd, they are to be registerd before employing them to the work. As per Karnataka state Government order LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore dated 01.01.2007 and Government letter no PW/134/BMS/2007 dated 27.07.2007, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labour welfare fund.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

All the formats prescribed in the bid document shall be filled by the Tenderer in complete manner other wise it will be rejected. The intending contractors are requested to note that they should abide by the detailed instructions and conditions contained in the Standard Bid document KW -4
Conditional tenders will not be accepted.
The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender, and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs.
The cost of the Tender processing fee shall not be refundable.
Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt. orders.
The employer reserves the rights to Reject or accept any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons.

In the case of the death of the contractor after executing the agreement / commencement of the work, his legal heir, if is an eligible registered contractor and is willing can execute and compete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of the work.

The successful Tenderer shall deliver to the Employer a Security deposit in any of the forms given below for an amount equivalent to 5% of the Contract price plus additional security for unbalanced tenders in accordance with Clause 25.5 & 29.1 of ITT and Clause 44 of the Conditions of Contract.
Contractor should establish a fully functional laboratory at site at no extra cost in order to carry out all the required tests for the materials being used in the project.

Contractor should take all precautions to ensure that no damage is caused to the existing canal CD works and other similar structures which have been constructed by other agencies during project execution. If any damage is caused, it has to be rectified at his own risk and cost.
Contractor should carryout additional test required to test the suitability of materials including borrow area before using the same either as sub-grade or base course materials.

All safety precautions, warning signs, night illumination, reflectors, deployment of security guards has to be ensured so that no untoward incident happens on account of negligence or any project activity. Contractor should indemnify the client to that extent.

All safety precautions, warning signs, night illumination, reflectors, deployment of security guards has to be ensured so that no untoward incident happens on account of negligence or any project activity. Contractor should indemnify the client to that extent.

Contractor should adhere to HSE policy applicable for similar projects. Contractor to that extent should submit HSE document defining all the procedure including the policies before execution of the project.

When embankments are constructed disputes arising on account of damages to the existing field / channels, bunds and other private properties, if any, has to be resolved by the contractor. All precautions should be taken by the contractor so that there are no damages to such public private properties.
Contractor should take all precautionary measures to avoid any damage to the utilities during excavation as well as utility shifting. To that extent the contractor should indemnify the client.

The tenderer who quotes amount less than amount put to tender should pay difference amount in the form of FDR purchased through any nationalized bank payable at Tumkur only in favor The Executive Engineer at the time of execution of the tender agreement.
If any postponement of receipt date of tender, the same will be published in the KPP Portal portal.

All the originals of uploaded documents in KPP portal should be produced within 7 working days from the date of opening of Technical Bid at the Division Office, failing which the tender is liable for rejection. No separate communication will be made in this regard, failing which action will be taken as per tender conditions and registration rules.
Further particulars, if any, required by the Contractor can be had from the office of the Executive Engineer, PWD, Division,Kolar during office hours on all working days

The contractor who participates in tenders for more than one work for which tenders are invited in this IFT, the tenderer must fulfill all the conditions and criteria cumulatively for the participated works.

The returns submitted to the I.T. along with the Profit and Loss account statement should be uploaded for the financial turnover criteria attested by Chartered Accountant. The Turnover certificate should be obtained from the Chartered Accountant having UDIN number, if failed to satisfy the condition the tender will be Rejected

The intending contractors are requested to note that they should abide by the detailed instructions and conditions contained in the Standard Tender documents KW-4 K.P.W.D. and further orders there on.
Contractor should execute the project with least impact to the environment especially during Cement concrete work.

Materials like bitumen, steel, cement etc., required for the work shall be procured by the tenderer and should get it tested by the quality control authority before using it for the work at their own cost.
MSME and NSIC Certificates are not valid as EMD payment as per GO.295/2019/ Dt. 26-03-2019.
The defect liability period for this project shall be 2 years
As per govt circular LAC LAW198/2024 Dated 30/11/2024 Arbitration clause was Deleted.
Bidder Should submit the Original bank Gaurantee of EMD on before the last date and time notified in the tender document to the Office of Excecutive Engineer PWD Division Kolar

The quantities for the necessary deviation road and cofferdam are provided on a one-time basis in the BOQ and any additional quantities required for completion of the work shall be deemed included in the Contractors rates, no extra payment shall be admissible, and such works shall be executed at the Contractors own cost and risk
The time period for completion of this work is 9 months
The Contractor should have not gone through termination of any work

The contractor / supplier shall attach scanned Bank Guarantee along with the bid on KP-procurement portal and submit the original Bank Guarantee to the Executive Engineer PWD Division Kolar on before the last date and time notified in the Tender Document to the Tender Inviting authority. If The Contractor fails to submit such tenders will be rejected.
Contractors registered with Class II and above KPWD License can participate in this tender
Estimate rates are excluding GST as per common SR 2023-24 continued to 2026-27

technicalCriterionList.description: 3.2 b. To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-26 satisfactorily completed(Atleast 90% of the Contract Value) as a prime contractor for at least one similar work such as construction of bridge work to an extent of 50% of the cost of the work, such as Bridge work of value not less than Rs.160.60 Lakhs (Past experience ) Certified duly by the 0fficer not below the rank of Executive Engineer.

3.2 c. executed in any one year, the following minimum 80% quantities of work:1) RCC/PCC in Cum-1277.00 2) TMT Steel in Tonnes-81.00 3)Earth work Excavation & embankment/ Subgrade/Earthen Shoulder In Cum-6230.00 (80% of peak rate of construction)
